question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off `tools.exec.pty` config default for non-sandbox exec, or keep PTY as a per-call-only tool parameter?
rationale: The source reproduction is clear, but the requested fix adds a global shell-exec default that affects security-sensitive operator behavior, sandbox expectations, and approval-backed execution.

options.title: Approve Narrow Config Default
options.body: Add the optional default while preserving current default behavior, per-call override precedence, gateway approval coverage, and explicit sandbox suppression/warning coordination.

options.title: Keep Per-Call Only
options.body: Avoid another exec config knob and instead improve docs or skill guidance for calls that need PTY.

options.title: Defer For Exec Policy Review
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers decide a broader exec configuration and PTY policy direction.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Config Default
recommendation.body: Add the optional default while preserving current default behavior, per-call override precedence, gateway approval coverage, and explicit sandbox suppression/warning coordination.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history on original PTY support, PTY fallback behavior, and adjacent exec docs/runtime decisions.
